facts.text: A multi-panel character reference sheet on a dark background, with a labeled hero image at the top and smaller study panels arranged below.

The hero panel shows a single standing person seen in full body on a wet, dark outdoor walkway at night, with metal railings on both sides, falling rain, and blurred warm bokeh lights in the background.
The person has short hair with shaved sides and a small top-knot bun at the back of the head, and appears to be of East Asian descent.
The person wears an all-black outfit: a black jacket with strap-and-buckle details at the chest and collar, a dark shirt underneath, black cargo-style trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
Visible on-screen labels are 'HERO', 'FRONT', 'SIDE PROFILE', 'BACK', 'FACE', 'JACKET COLLAR', 'HANDS', and 'BOOTS'.
The 'FRONT' panel shows the person standing straight, facing the camera, arms relaxed at the sides against a plain dark grey studio backdrop.
The 'SIDE PROFILE' panel shows the person in profile facing left, showing the top-knot bun and the jacket's side silhouette.
The 'BACK' panel shows the person from behind, showing the jacket's back panel and shoulder seams and the hair gathered at the back of the head.
The 'FACE' close-up shows a neutral, direct gaze, defined cheekbones, a small scar or mark above the left eyebrow, and short cropped hair on the sides.
The 'JACKET COLLAR' close-up shows a dark textured jacket collar with a metal buckle and strap and a zipper at the neck.
The 'HANDS' close-up shows two weathered hands with visible veins and knuckles resting in a dark setting.
The 'BOOTS' close-up shows worn black leather lace-up boots with thick soles and creased toes.
Lighting is low-key and cool in the hero panel, with warm accent lights behind, while the turnaround panels use even, dim studio lighting with dark grey backgrounds.
The overall palette is near-monochrome black and charcoal with cool blue-grey highlights and small warm amber light accents.
